title: Turmeric Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Turmeric Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Turmeric nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen and potassium in luyang dilaw, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Turmeric nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your luyang dilaw (turmeric) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus, iron, magnesium, zinc, sulfur and manganese. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

heroImage.alt: Nitrogen deficiency on a leaf, shown on another crop as a stand in for turmeric
heroImage.credit: Maja Dumat, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus and magnesium move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But iron, zinc, sulfur and manganese stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which turmeric nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a turmeric nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest turmeric nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in turmeric

Pale or yellow green leaves appear first on the older leaves. Reddish tints start at the leaf edges and spread toward the midrib. Leaves are small, growth slows markedly and rhizome yield drops. You see it most at this stage: from planting to about 4 months.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Worn out or sandy soils, heavy rain and too little fertilizer.
How to tell it apart
Magnesium deficiency yellows between the veins with an arrowhead at the leaf base. Leaf spot gives spots, not an even pale color. To be sure, check that the old leaves yellowed first. Soil test.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

Give 140 kg N per hectare as urea in five splits (at planting and 30, 60, 90 and 120 days after), with 60 kg P2O5 and 60 kg K2O. For quick help spray 2 percent DAP 18 46 0 (20 g per liter) or 1 percent urea (10 g per liter), twice a week apart.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (46 0 0), **YaraVera Viking Ship Granular Urea** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (46 0 0), **Planters Products Granular Urea** by Planters Products, Inc. (46 0 0) and **Harbest Granular Urea** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (46 0 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, mulch and add compost.
Potassium deficiency in turmeric
Growth slows and internodes shorten. Leaf edges burn brown and dead spots form in the leaf, fewer side shoots grow, and plants wilt easily. You see it most at this stage: rhizome bulking.
Why potassium deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Sandy, leached soils and fields without potash.
How to tell it apart
Leaf blotch disease gives small spots over the leaf, not burned edges. To be sure, soil test for potassium.
What to apply for potassium deficiency
Give 90 kg potassium per hectare in four splits (at planting and 60, 90 and 120 days after), or a 1 percent potassium sulfate spray (10 g per liter) every 15 days.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Philphos Muriate of Potash** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Harbest Granular Muriate of Potash** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (0 0 60) and **Swire Muriate of Potash** by Swire Agrotech Agricultural Products Inc. (0 0 60). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, split potash through the season and add compost or ash.
Phosphorus deficiency in turmeric
Growth slows and leaf color deepens, with browning or purple in some plants. Stems are thin, fewer side shoots form and the lower leaves are lost. You see it most at this stage: early growth.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Acid and volcanic soils that hold phosphorus.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency makes leaves paler, not darker. To be sure, soil test for available phosphorus.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency

Soak 6 kg superphosphate in 100 liters of water overnight, takes the clear liquid, adds 150 g urea, 150 g magnesium sulfate, 150 g ferrous sulfate and 100 g borax. Sprays it every 15 days until symptoms go. For the soil, apply phosphorus at planting following the soil test.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (0 46 0), **Sagrex Duofos Granular Guano Phosphate** by Sagrex Corporation (0 22 0 (guano phosphate)), **Philphos 18 46 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0 (diammonium phosphate)) and **Atlas Di Ammonium Phosphate** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, apply phosphorus at planting each season.
Iron deficiency in turmeric
Young leaves show yellow between the veins first, and it spreads quickly over the whole leaf. In severe cases the leaves turn completely white. You see it most at this stage: from the third month.
Why iron deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
High pH soils, waterlogging and low potassium.
How to tell it apart
Manganese deficiency gives a mottled light green look rather than full bleaching. To be sure, soil pH test and a leaf test.
What to apply for iron deficiency
Give 30 kg ferrous sulfate per hectare to the soil, followed by sprays of 2.5 kg ferrous sulfate per hectare in the third, fourth and fifth months.

Sold here with iron: **Ferrous Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Cleveland Industries Inc. (20 percent iron), **Ferrous Sulfate Monohydrate** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (30 percent iron), **Grow More Liquid Chelate Iron with Sulfur** by Sagrex Corporation (5 percent iron and 3 percent sulfur) and **Biozome** by Manchem Industries, Inc. (12 percent S, 12 percent Zn, 3 percent Mn, 1 percent Mg, 1 percent Fe, 1 percent Cu, 0.5 percent B, 0.05 percent Mo). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [iron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/iron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, plant on well drained beds and keep organic matter high.
Magnesium deficiency in turmeric

Symptoms start on older leaves, which may drop or show a triangular arrowhead near the leaf stalk. Leaves yellow at the edges and between the veins until the whole leaf is yellow, and growth slows. You see it most at this stage: mid season.
Why magnesium deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Acid, sandy soils and heavy potash.
How to tell it apart
Potassium deficiency burns the leaf edges brown. To be sure, soil test for magnesium.
What to apply for magnesium deficiency

Give a 0.5 percent magnesium sulfate spray (5 g Epsom salt per liter) every 15 days until symptoms go. Give about 80 kg magnesium sulfate per hectare (32 kg per acre) in bands near the plants. Apply it apart from potash.

Sold here with magnesium: **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource Limited Corporation (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **YaraTera KRISTA MgS** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (16 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur), **Magnepro** by Ramgo International Corporation (16 percent MgO and 12.8 percent sulfur) and **Lucky Planters Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate (Epsom Salt)** by Mindanao Agriplus Corporation (16.27 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [complete fertilizer](/blog/complete-fertilizer-14-14-14), and the page on [magnesium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/magnesium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, use dolomite on acid soils.
Zinc deficiency in turmeric
Leaves yellow between the veins and come out small and distorted, bunched in a rosette at the top. Plants branch less and roots are short. You see it most at this stage: early growth.
Why zinc deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
High pH soils and heavy phosphorus.
How to tell it apart
Iron deficiency bleaches young leaves without bunching. To be sure, soil test for zinc.
What to apply for zinc deficiency
Give about 20 kg Zinc sulfate per hectare (8 kg per acre) to the soil, or in severe cases a morning spray of 2 g zinc sulfate with 2.5 g lime per liter. Keep zinc and phosphate applications apart.

Sold here with zinc: **Harvester Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Universal Harvester, Inc. (22 percent zinc), **Great Planters Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Agway Chemicals Corp. (21 percent zinc), **Zinc Sulphate Monohydrate** by Petbowe Trading Corporation (33 percent zinc) and **YaraVita ZINTRAC 700** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (40 percent zinc). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [fertilizer with zinc](/blog/micronutrients-for-rice), and the page on [zinc deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/zinc-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep the soil pH between 5 and 7.5.
Sulfur deficiency in turmeric
Plants stay stunted and the leaves turn pale yellow, veins and all, until the whole leaf is chlorotic. Stems are thin and maturity is late. You see it most at this stage: early to mid growth.
Why sulfur deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
Soils low in organic matter and burning crop waste.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency starts on the old leaves with red tinted edges. To be sure, soil and leaf test for sulfur.
What to apply for sulfur deficiency

Give a spray of 5 g magnesium sulfate with 10 g urea per liter every 15 days. Use a sulfur bearing fertilizer such as Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0 or single superphosphate. Give about 25 kg sulfur dust per hectare (10 kg per acre) on sulfur poor soils, or Gypsum on alkaline soils.

Sold here with sulfur: **Farmfix Sulfur** by Philippine FarmFix, Inc. (99 percent sulfur), **VSI Sulfur Powder** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (99.5 percent sulfur), **Atlas Ammosul** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (21 0 0 with 24 percent sulfur) and **Philphos 21 0 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (21 0 0 (ammonium sulfate)). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [ammonium sulfate fertilizer](/blog/ammonium-sulfate-21-0-0), and the page on [sulfur deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/sulfur-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, add organic matter and stop burning trash.
Manganese deficiency in turmeric
Symptoms show on new growth: leaves look mottled, light green to yellow green between the veins. Older leaves stay green. You see it most at this stage: early to mid growth.
Why manganese deficiency happens in luyang dilaw
High pH and over limed soils.
How to tell it apart
Iron deficiency bleaches young leaves more strongly. To be sure, leaf test for manganese.
What to apply for manganese deficiency
Give a 0.5 percent manganese sulfate spray (5 g per liter), twice a week apart.

Sold here with manganese: **Manganese Sulfate** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (31 percent manganese), **Tierramino Mn** by Unilox Far East Resources Inc. (12 percent manganese and 7 percent N), **Multimate** by Agway Chemicals Corp. (1.8 percent Mn, 2.8 percent Zn, 4 percent N, 4.5 percent S (w/v)) and **Biozome** by Manchem Industries, Inc. (12 percent S, 12 percent Zn, 3 percent Mn, 1 percent Mg, 1 percent Fe, 1 percent Cu, 0.5 percent B, 0.05 percent Mo). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [manganese deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/manganese-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, do not over lime.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any turmeric nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your luyang dilaw needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Turmeric nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my luyang dilaw leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: older leaves pale yellow green with red tints creeping from the edges to the midrib. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at iron deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in turmeric?
items.a: Give 140 kg N per hectare as urea in five splits (at planting and 30, 60, 90 and 120 days after), with 60 kg P2O5 and 60 kg K2O. For quick help spray 2 percent DAP 18 46 0 (20 g per liter) or 1 percent urea (10 g per liter), twice a week apart.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in turmeric?
items.a: Give 90 kg potassium per hectare in four splits (at planting and 60, 90 and 120 days after), or a 1 percent potassium sulfate spray (10 g per liter) every 15 days.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes phosphorus deficiency in turmeric?
items.a: Soak 6 kg superphosphate in 100 liters of water overnight, takes the clear liquid, adds 150 g urea, 150 g magnesium sulfate, 150 g ferrous sulfate and 100 g borax. Sprays it every 15 days until symptoms go.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my luyang dilaw lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the turmeric nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
